verdict.rationale: Decagon's overview page claims technical teams 'retain full visibility and control over... versioning' of agent configurations, and Simulations/Experiments allow testing and controlled rollout before production changes, implying some review workflow. However, there is no concrete documentation of how versions are tracked, compared, or explicitly rolled back — the claim is a single passing phrase, not a described feature with UI or workflow detail. Missing for 10: dedicated version-history UI, diff/review workflow, explicit rollback mechanism, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
